method: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer 'Full Filing' render of the IRS e-file XML (same IRS object IDs as on IRS TEOS). ProPublica's raw XML download endpoint returns a 403 'Security Check' page to curl (checked earlier for Northeastern), so it was not used and was not bypassed; the rendered pages are openly served. Column A equals B+C+D on every line read (asserted in code).

Schedule H facility list was read for FY25 only; the FY24 return also answers line 20a Yes.

The Leland Stanford Junior University.scope_note: Part IV line 20a (hospital facilities) is No and line 12a No / 12b Yes (both returns). Schedule R Part II lists Stanford Health Care, Lucile Salter Packard Children's Hospital, Stanford Health Care Tri-Valley, Packard Children's Health Alliance and University Healthcare Alliance as related exempt organizations that file separately; the audited consolidated statements include Stanford Health Care and LPCH. So the 990 is the university-side scope only and its lines 5-10 total is the percentage of the consolidated audited 'Salaries and benefits' line shown in c_990_l5_to_l10_as_pct_of_audited. Whether SLAC personnel are inside the 990 was not determined from Part IX; SLAC employees are University employees per the audited notes.

caveats: Tax-year labels: IRS forms are labelled by the calendar year in which the tax year begins. 'TY 2024 Form 990' is the FY25 return (tax year ending June 30, 2025 for Penn; August 31, 2025 for Northwestern and Stanford). All six returns were filed (submission dates 2026-05-14, 2026-07-14, 2026-07-15 for FY25; 2025-05-14, 2025-07-14, 2025-07-15 for FY24). ProPublica lists a separate Form 990-T for each year; those were not used.
Fiscal-year alignment: each 990 tax year matches the audited fiscal year used in the audited combined line (Penn June 30; Northwestern and Stanford August 31).

Audited combined lines come from the institution JSONs in this folder (sw_combined_with_benefits): Northwestern FY25 1,997,951,000 and FY24 1,832,098,000; Penn FY25 9,019,270,000 and FY24 8,398,503,000; Stanford FY25 11,647,045,000 and FY24 10,757,678,000. They were not re-verified against the audited PDFs in this task.

Nothing is scaled or estimated. For Penn and Stanford the audited combined line consolidates hospital systems, so the 990 to audited comparison is a scope comparison, not a reconciliation. The S&W share (b) is reported as printed in each filing's Part IX; applying it to the consolidated line would be an estimate and was not done.

Row text is a reconstruction of the printed rows from ProPublica's render of the IRS e-file data; columns are A (total), B (program services), C (management and general), D (fundraising); blank columns are omitted.
